terra.problem: It reduces the controversies and disputes about words to one little argument, which the text does not say.
“Peace isn't what they're after” assigns the men a motive beyond what Paul says. He says they regard godliness as a means of gain.
“Paul wants us to take it seriously” attributes an unstated intention to Paul.
Even marked as a guess, saying the line is meant to make us examine our hearts adds a purpose the text does not state.
The joke about a rough set of friends makes light of imagined people causing the suffering described on a serious card.
